name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_on_destroy
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::OnDestroy begins disconnect when needed, pumps WOL callbacks until abort, kills the refresh timer, shuts down the API, and destroys the progress dialog window.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43e160 validates the abort guard, BeginDisconnectAndShowProgress call, ProcessCallbacks loop through WOL COM vtable offset 0x0c, Sleep(200), KillTimer on the dialog HWND with timer id 4, WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApi::Shutdown, and progress-window DestroyWindow dispatch through vtable offset 0x60.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_on_destroy_smoke patches BeginDisconnectAndShowProgress, Sleep, KillTimer, and WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApi::Shutdown, uses a fake progress-window DestroyWindow provider, and verifies both already-aborted and loop-until-abort paths.
